bataille.title: Goal
bataille.text: Win all the cards. Alone against the computer, or with 2 to 6 players.

bataille.title: A round
bataille.text: Each player turns over their top card. The highest card wins all the cards of the round. Tap the table to send them, shuffled, under the pile of its player. Ace is highest, 2 is lowest.

bataille.title: Battle
bataille.text: When several players have the highest card, only they lay one card face down, then one face up. The highest card takes them all, the other players' cards included. If you have a single card left, it is your face up card. Without any card, you lose the battle. Once the battle is won, each tap on the table collects one layer of cards, from the top; a layer of hidden cards is turned over first.

bataille.title: Out
bataille.text: Without any card, you are out. The last player with cards wins.

bataille.title: With a keyboard
bataille.text: Enter or Space on your pile plays a card. With several players, each one has a key, written on their pile: L, A, G, P, X, M. When a round is won, Space, Enter or a player's key collects the cards layer by layer, turning over the hidden ones first.

spider.title: Goal
spider.text: Build sequences from king down to ace in one suit. A complete sequence goes to the places at the top left; fill them all to win.

spider.title: Moving
spider.text: A card goes on the rank just above: a 6 on a 7. A same-suit run moves as one. An empty column takes anything. A greyed card cannot move for now.

spider.title: Stock
spider.text: It deals one card on each column. It is only possible when every column holds at least one card.

spider.title: Help
spider.text: The light bulb suggests a move, the arrow undoes the last move. Each undo counts as a move.

spider.title: With a keyboard
spider.text: Tab goes from card to card, Enter or Space plays the card as a tap would, then picks the column. Escape puts the raised cards down.
